picks.name: K-LONE
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Have a Few Days Off" (September 18, 2026) is his first outing on Wisdom Teeth since 2023's "Swells" -- a six-track mini-LP absorbing his full range of touchstones, from swinging minimal house through autonomic drum & bass to drifting ambient techno.
picks.why_listen: Vivid, joyful club production with real range -- bright chords and buoyant basslines that can slot into a warm-up or a peak-time turn.

picks.name: Hodge (feat. Eris Drew & Om Unit remixes)
picks.source_note: New release on Local Action, a label you already follow. Remixes from Eris Drew and Om Unit, both already in your library.
picks.bio: "Wiggler / Trust (with Eris Drew & Om Unit Remixes)" (August 11, 2026, LOC089) gives both tracks from Hodge's spring single a remix treatment -- Eris Drew reworks "Wiggler," Om Unit reworks "Trust."
picks.why_listen: Two trusted remixers you already play, applied to a strong original -- solid, versatile material for a driving stretch of a set.
